title: RNA Isolation from Human Intervertebral Disc Tissue
author: Nashrah Ahmad
materials: Removal of Allprotect®, weighing, and tissue preparation
Pre-cool the tissue pulverizer (cell crusher) with LN₂.

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Process human lower thoracic and entire lumbar spines within 48 hours post-mortem.

substeps.instruction: Resect IVDs from the spine and separate AF and NP.
Cut into smaller pieces and place immediately in 4 ml of Allprotect® in 5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Store at 4°C overnight, then transfer to -80°C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Tissue Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the required amount of tissue for processing.

substeps.instruction: Gently remove residual Allprotect® using a Kimwipe and briefly rinse the tissue with PBS.
Cut a section of approximately 50 mg for AF or 200 mg for NP and weigh (cut additional slices if necessary).
Snap-freeze the tissue in liquid nitrogen and transfer to a new tube on dry ice or keep in LN₂.

steps.title: Tissue Pulverization
steps.instruction: Pulverize the frozen tissue into a fine powder using a pre-cooled cell crusher.

substeps.instruction: Place frozen tissue into the pre-cooled cell crusher and add LN₂.
Pulverize to a fine powder using a hammer, rotating the cell crusher after each impact.
Perform this quickly to ensure the cell crusher and tissue do not warm up.

steps.title: Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the pulverized tissue in TRIzol™.

substeps.instruction: Transfer pulverized tissue to a 2 mL tube containing 1 mL of ice-cold TRIzol™ using a clean spatula.
Vortex for 20 seconds, then place on ice for 1 minute; repeat this cycle 3 times total.
Incubate samples on a rotator at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm at 4°C for 30 seconds.
Transfer the supernatant (~1 mL) to a new pre-cooled 2 mL tube and store at -80°C or proceed immediately.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Perform a triple chloroform extraction to isolate the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of chloroform to the homogenate, shake vigorously for 15 seconds, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm at 4°C for 10 minutes and collect the upper aqueous phase into a new microcentrifuge tube.
Repeat the chloroform addition (200 μL), shaking, 2-minute RT incubation, and centrifugation (12,000 rpm, 4°C, 10 min) a second time, collecting the aqueous phase.
Repeat the chloroform addition (200 μL), shaking, 2-minute RT incubation, and centrifugation (12,000 rpm, 4°C, 10 min) a third and final time, collecting the final upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to RNeasy spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of 70% RNase-free ethanol (e.g., 300–400 μL) to the aqueous phase.
Mix gently and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Load 700 μL of the sample onto an RNeasy spin column (Note: For NP samples, divide the sample into four parts and load onto four columns to prevent clogging).
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000 rpm at RT and discard flow-through; repeat until the entire sample has passed through.

steps.title: First DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of DNA digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL of Buffer RW1 to the spin column, centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000 rpm at RT, and discard flow-through and collection tube.
Prepare DNase reaction: mix 70 μL of DNA digestion buffer (Zymo) with 10 μL of Zymo DNase I (80 μL total).
Pipette the 80 μL reaction directly onto the column membrane and incubate for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 350 μL of Buffer RW1, centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000 rpm at RT, and discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Second DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of DNA digestion.

substeps.instruction: Prepare another DNase reaction: mix 70 μL of DNA digestion buffer (Zymo) with 10 μL of Zymo DNase I (80 μL total).
Pipette the 80 μL reaction directly onto the column membrane and incubate for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 350 μL of Buffer RW1, centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000 rpm at RT, and discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Column Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane and dry it before elution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new collection tube and add 500 μL of Buffer RPE.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8,000 rpm at RT and discard flow-through.
Add another 500 μL of Buffer RPE and centrifuge for 2 minutes at >8,000 rpm at RT; discard flow-through.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge for 2 minutes at full speed (16,000 × g) at RT to dry the membrane.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the RNeasy column to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 15 μL of RNase-free water to the membrane and incubate for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at >8,000 rpm for 15 seconds at RT.
Return the same 15 μL eluate onto the column membrane, incubate for 1 minute, and centrifuge again for 1 minute at >8,000 rpm at RT.
Store the eluted RNA at -80°C.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration, purity, and integrity of the eluted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Apply 1 μL of RNA to a NanoDrop™ 1000 to measure concentration and purity.
Use 2 μL of RNA on the 4150 TapeStation System to determine the RNA Integrity Number (RIN).
